product_recovery_targets.scope: Prospective additional product targets; failure retains experimental HOLD even if a relative direction is established.
product_recovery_targets.freshness_nonregression: Both candidate p95/max material and verified actor ages no worse than the worse same-source stock Safe reference; withheld actor fraction no worse. An omitted actor is never a zero-age improvement.
product_recovery_targets.resource_nonregression: Report actual-process peak/RSS/commit samples separately from capture clocks. Candidate peak RSS must not exceed worse stock reference by more than one full 2048 RGBA image ring (32 MiB) plus 10 percent. Five-minute native graphical authoring/lifecycle and bounded retained-resource tests remain mandatory before delivery selection.
